summary: Checkout p95 rose from ~180 ms to ~2.8 s two minutes after release v2026.08.03-1 finished deploying. The release defaulted reservation.batch_mode to false, so each order issues one inventory reserve call per line item; checkout->inventory dependency latency and inventory request rate rose in step while payments and PayVault stayed flat. Rolling back the checkout release is the recommended mitigation.

primary_hypothesis.statement: Checkout release v2026.08.03-1 set reservation.batch_mode=false, fanning out one inventory reserve call per line item and multiplying checkout latency
primary_hypothesis.reasoning: Onset at 08:11 follows the 08:09-08:11 deployment; change notes name the batch_mode default; logs show per-item reserve fan-out; only the inventory dependency latency rose.

hypotheses_considered.statement: Checkout release v2026.08.03-1 set reservation.batch_mode=false, fanning out one inventory reserve call per line item and multiplying checkout latency
hypotheses_considered.reasoning: Onset at 08:11 follows the 08:09-08:11 deployment; change notes name the batch_mode default; logs show per-item reserve fan-out; only the inventory dependency latency rose.

hypotheses_considered.statement: PayVault latency is slowing checkout through payments

key_findings.statement: Checkout is degraded at the investigation clock with p95 far above its typical value
Exactly one checkout deployment (v2026.08.03-1) landed in the six hours before onset, finishing at 08:11
Checkout p95 latency steps up by more than an order of magnitude at 08:11-08:15
Checkout->inventory dependency latency rose sharply at the same time
Checkout logs show per-line-item inventory reserve fan-out with batch_mode=false
Inventory request rate multiplied while inventory itself stayed healthy
The release changed reservation fan-out, which is sufficient to explain the latency multiplier

contradicting_evidence.statement: A PayVault latency warning fired at 08:20 but resolved within minutes
Checkout->payments dependency latency remained flat through the incident

recommended_actions.action: Roll back checkout to the previous release
recommended_actions.rationale: Onset matches the deployment and the runbook describes a safe rollback

recommended_actions.action: Re-ship the reservation refactor only with reservation.batch_mode=true or the batch reserve API
recommended_actions.rationale: The fan-out is the mechanism visible in the logs

unknowns.statement: Whether the batch reserve API on inventory is ready for production

limitations: Synthetic environment: no direct view of code diffs, only deployment change notes
